#!/Users/mark/Desktop/AI/Pivotal/.venv/bin/python
"""UCI stub that always plays the first legal move and reports a huge eval swing.

game.py uses this binary as the engine:
  - analyse(): resigns if score.white() < -500 after Black's move
  - play(): engine reply

We answer `go` with bestmove = first legal move, and an info line whose cp
is hugely negative for White when it is White to move (i.e. after Black moved),
and modestly positive otherwise so we don't resign on our own turn (analyse is
only called after Black's move anyway).
"""
import sys
import chess

board = chess.Board()

def first_legal(b: chess.Board) -> str:
    moves = list(b.legal_moves)
    return moves[0].uci() if moves else "0000"

def handle_position(parts):
    global board
    # position [fen <fen> | startpos] [moves <m1> ...]
    if "startpos" in parts:
        board = chess.Board()
        if "moves" in parts:
            idx = parts.index("moves")
            for u in parts[idx+1:]:
                board.push_uci(u)
    elif "fen" in parts:
        idx = parts.index("fen")
        # fen is 6 fields, then optional moves
        fen_parts = parts[idx+1:idx+7]
        fen = " ".join(fen_parts)
        board = chess.Board(fen)
        if "moves" in parts:
            midx = parts.index("moves")
            for u in parts[midx+1:]:
                board.push_uci(u)
    else:
        board = chess.Board()

def emit_go():
    # After Black moves, side to move is White. Report a hopeless score for White
    # so game.py's resignation check fires. Also fine if called as play().
    if board.turn == chess.WHITE:
        cp = -2000
    else:
        cp = 20
    mv = first_legal(board)
    sys.stdout.write(f"info depth 1 score cp {cp} pv {mv}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"bestmove {mv}\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()

def main():
    while True:
        line = sys.stdin.readline()
        if not line:
            break
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split()
        cmd = parts[0]
        if cmd == "uci":
            sys.stdout.write("id name WeakStub 1.0\n")
            sys.stdout.write("id author local\n")
            sys.stdout.write("option name Skill Level type spin default 0 min 0 max 20\n")
            sys.stdout.write("uciok\n")
            sys.stdout.flush()
        elif cmd == "isready":
            sys.stdout.write("readyok\n")
            sys.stdout.flush()
        elif cmd == "ucinewgame":
            global board
            board = chess.Board()
        elif cmd == "setoption":
            pass
        elif cmd == "position":
            try:
                handle_position(parts)
            except Exception as e:
                sys.stderr.write(f"pos err {e} line={line}\n")
        elif cmd == "go":
            try:
                emit_go()
            except Exception as e:
                sys.stderr.write(f"go err {e}\n")
                sys.stdout.write("bestmove 0000\n")
                sys.stdout.flush()
        elif cmd == "quit":
            break
        elif cmd == "stop":
            emit_go()
        else:
            pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
